nodes.name: Meta Verify (GET)
nodes.notes: Meta calls this once when you subscribe the webhook. It must echo hub.challenge.

nodes.name: Messenger Webhook
nodes.notes: Every inbound message and delivery receipt from the page arrives here.

nodes.name: Whose Page Is It?
nodes.notes: Routing several pages to several businesses, instead of the one META_BUSINESS_CODE names.

'instagram_dm' : 'meta_dm', external_id: $json.psid, buyer_name: $json.buyer_name || 'Buyer', buyer_handle: $json.psid, body: $json.message, message_external_id: $json.message_id }) }}

nodes.name: Read The Thread
nodes.notes: The last forty lines, so the draft answers what was actually asked rather than only the newest sentence.

nodes.name: Ask Ollama
nodes.notes: If Ollama is down this comes back without a response and the next node files nothing, leaving the desk to be released rather than filing an empty draft for someone to approve.

nodes.name: File The Draft
nodes.notes: PENDING. Nothing has reached the buyer; the desk now reads AWAITING_APPROVAL until a human clicks.

nodes.name: Ack Meta
nodes.notes: Meta retries anything not acknowledged within a few seconds.
